freeze_scope: Recorded before strategy returns were calculated. Not a prospective registration; historical markets are familiar and source prices may be revised.
rebalance: First eligible close then last supplied session of each month; frozen percentages; floor each risky weight to whole percentage and assign remainder to G.
momentum_rule: Select positive total-return momentum from t-252 to t-21; equal allocation across selected risky funds, caps and trailing covariance scale down only. Static selects all four and otherwise uses identical caps and scaling.
request_clock: Next supplied session at 11:00 America/New_York after one complete intervening publication session; ordinarily post at that day's closing NAV, modeled, not guaranteed.
cost_interpretation: Hypothetical proportional allocation friction on gross traded notional; not a TSP commission or measured spread. Fund operating expenses and investment income are already in NAV.
inference: Paired daily log-return difference momentum minus risk-matched static, annualized mean and 95% moving-block bootstrap intervals; block lengths 20 and 63, 2000 replications, seed 20261023. Descriptive inference, no parameter or scenario selection by results.
yearly_walk_forward: Continuous holdings and strictly trailing features; fixed rules, per-year metrics, no annual reset or holdout tuning.
negative_results: Publish all strategies, predefined windows, all nine cost/delay scenarios, both bootstrap intervals, including negative and insignificant results.
limitations: Current-vintage NAV data, no archived release vintages or exact historical publication timestamps
Restricted-access retirement funds, not exchange-traded ETFs
Whole-percent targets and monthly transfer-count audit approximate core plan mechanics; no participant, tax, contribution, withdrawal or exception simulator
I Fund benchmark changed in 2024; series is the actual changing fund, not a constant global-equity index
